palette.description: 밝은 골드 + 짙은 앰버 / 차콜 배경

basis: 사용자가 지정한9개 형태를 같은색으로 비교. 색 미지정에 따라 기존 DUNE 골드로 테스트. 최종안 승인 아님.
limitation: AI 편집이므로 원본과 픽셀 단위 기하 일치를 보장하지 않음. 출발 시안 병렬 비교로 변화 확인.

concepts.name: 네거티브 플로 · 정돈 · 투톤
concepts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: DUNE app icon palette-normalization test, one image, square opaque unmasked artwork. Input image 1 is the exact edit target: 86 네거티브 플로 · 정돈. Change ONLY color, preserve the original geometry, count and connectivity of ribbons, curve profiles, stroke widths, gaps, endpoints, crossing order, material style, composition, size and position. Do not redesign, simplify or thicken the artwork. All nine icons in this experiment share ONE monochromatic DUNE gold family on the SAME charcoal background. Background must be uniform #302b2a to all four edges, with no green, navy, teal or purple tint. Main lit ribbon color #e1b453; use only same-hue gold tonal shading (highlight #f5d778, shade #9f793b) where necessary to preserve original overlap and depth. Convert EVERY colored ribbon to this same gold hue family; no cyan, blue, mint, sage, purple, pink or white ribbon. Preserve original relative shading and subtle transparency but render transmitted colors only as warm gold. Keep dark negative spaces background-charcoal. No new shadow, decorations, glow, metallic texture, text, frame, rounded tile or phone. Render exact original silhouette with recoloring only, 1024x1024 or larger square.
